halloween_disconnect.recognisability_note: Seasonal opt in pack. Players who turned it on last October would know it.

soundboard_quack.trigger: Default soundboard sound 'quack'. Anyone in a voice channel can play it for everyone in the channel from the soundboard button.
soundboard_quack.pack_about: Discord's built-in soundboard sounds. Not part of the client sound map; served from cdn.discordapp.com/soundboard-sounds/<id>.
soundboard_quack.recognisability_note: Soundboard staple, spammed in voice chats everywhere.
soundboard_quack.evidence: web.1cce76ccd5e996d2.js module 102597: https://${CDN_HOST}/soundboard-sounds/${id} (CDN_HOST cdn.discordapp.com in the login page GLOBAL_ENV); id 1. Short nasal 0.2 s burst, formant peak around 1.6-1.9 kHz: a duck quack. Also the API docs example (sound_id 1 = quack).
